units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 8:9">Erub. VIII, 9</cite> <he>שמבחוץ צריך לִקְמוֹר</he> the pit (<cite ref="P00331"><he>עוּקָה</he></cite>) outside of his private ground he must arch over; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S01452"><he>קָמוּר</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="S00042"><he>קְמוּרָה</he></cite> &c. Ib. 10 <he>ביב שהוא ק׳ וכ׳</he> a gutter covered up four cubits on public ground; Tosef. ib. IX (VI), 18; Y. ib. VIII, end, 25ᵇ. Ohol. III, 7. Ib. V, 1 <he>תנור … ועינו ק׳ לחוץ</he> an oven which stands in the house, but the arch over its ‘eye’ (fire-place) is outside the house; (R. Hai G. expl. <he>כָּמוּר וסדור</he>; v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. <he>קמר</he>).
Num. R. s. 12 אין צב אלא קְמוּרוֹת (not קמי׳) tsab (Num. VII, 3) means wagons with vaulted covers; a. e.
